title: "First Research Article" Fellowship Program

about: The Max Planck Institute for the History of Science in Berlin invites applications for its "First Research Article" Fellowship Program, 2027-28 cohort, running 1 September 2027 to 28 February 2028. Apply on or before 15 January 2027 (23:59 CET); decisions expected by 1 April 2027.
